## Workload

During the quarter, grader Marcus Bell completed 855 reads over 406 hours. This represents an average of 2.1 reads per hour. The recorded workload provides the basis for the review of activity during the period. The figures indicate the volume of work undertaken and the time associated with completing those reads. The workload information was considered alongside the quality findings below.

## Quality

A sample of 75 reads was checked as part of the quality review. Agreement for the checked reads was 72.0 per cent. Feedback was provided on borderline background cases to support consistency and clarify the application of review expectations. The findings should be considered together with the workload information, including the recorded reading rate.

The review was completed by Priya Anand. This document records the workload and quality information for the quarter and identifies the feedback provided during the review.
